Author: Steelgunner90
Name: FFXIV VR (Pose Sync test)
Description: A VR mod for FFXIV. Run /vr to open settings. Test build with pose sync: other players with this build can see your VR head and hand movements (Sync tab).
Punchline: A VR mod for FFXIV, with pose sync
Changelog:
# Pose sync test build
- Shared poses lean, bow and reach: your headset position bends the spine, the chest turns with your head and shoulders follow far reaches
- Game screen shake now reaches the VR view (View tab: Camera shake)
